narrative: I would like to report that I have been the victim of an online purchase fraud. About a month ago I found an advertisement on social media offering electronic products at attractive prices, from a company presenting itself as an established electronics trading business ('Prime Gulf Electronics'). The page looked professional, with product catalogs, customer reviews and delivery photos. I contacted the seller on WhatsApp using the number in the advertisement; he introduced himself as a sales representative, confirmed availability, and assured me delivery within a few days after payment. Believing the company was legitimate, on 8 September I transferred AED 12,500 for electronic devices to the account he provided: beneficiary Mubarak Salem, account 5660609, IBAN AE600340005660609. The seller confirmed receipt and said the order was being processed. The delivery never happened — my messages were ignored, the phone stopped responding and the social media page disappeared. I can provide the WhatsApp conversation, the payment confirmation and the beneficiary bank details. I request that the authorities investigate the individual who received the payment, the account, the company identity used in the advertisement, and any other victims connected to the same account.
